name: Gravekeeper
source:
Mike has an unfortunate accident and loses his life. Yet he opens his eyes inside a morgue and starts walking around normally. The world, however, is not ready for his kind, and under strict observation, he is forced to eliminate those who have also returned from the dead, but unlike him, can only wreak havoc.

[From [url=https://sakudoshi.itch.io/gravekeeper]Itch.io[/url]]
